name: Encouragement To Others
overview: Scripture teaches that encouragement is rooted in God's presence and strength, assuring believers that they need not fear because God upholds them with His righteousness (Isaiah 41:10). Believers are called to support one another by gathering together and exhorting each other, especially as they anticipate Christ's return (Hebrews 10:25). The hope and joy that come from the Holy Spirit empower Christians to abound in faith (Romans 15:13), while Christ's strength enables them to endure all challenges (Philippians 4:13). Those who persevere under temptation are promised the crown of life, highlighting the blessedness of steadfast faith (James 1:12).
